cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll keep the hall clear. Can I add one chair beside the noticeboard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll chair the tenants' meeting from it. Could you bring yours out when we start?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to furniture. I'm not joining your committee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just come and object, then. I'll introduce you as our first speaker.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 manages the hall and seeks permission; A3 claims chairmanship on that assent; A5 offers priority to keep a reluctant participant.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 chair permission causes A3 meeting reveal; B4 refusal causes the A5 objector invitation.

relationship.evidence: B4 distinguishes furniture consent from committee membership and A5 adjusts rather than denying that distinction.

heightening.evidence: A5 changes opposition into a speaking role, retaining the expanding commitment through B4 own concern.
